_comment: A passive that slows anything that hits the caster, 10 percent at level 1 rising to 30 percent at level 5, for 150 ticks (5 s), even when the hit was fully absorbed. Slows never stack: the strongest one wins, so a high-level FrostShield can mask a weaker Slow aura the caster is also running. No cost, since there is nothing to charge the victim of a hit for retaliating. All values placeholder.
name: FrostShield
description: Being hit is enough - it fires even when the hit is fully absorbed.
